# Vendored Soil core

These are the two core files the Mycelium site needs to compile without a
second checkout:

- `prelude.soil`
- `ui.soil`

Source: `ajmwagar/soil` at commit `0ae9c09af7eaa4b27655ff739994e6de76c357a8`.
Both are MIT OR Apache-2.0. Update them deliberately when the compiler core
changes.
